semantics: Kill switch. Every flag is on unless a founder turns it off; while off, the game API refuses the listed player commands with 409 feature_paused before they touch state. A flag can only pause what the deploy already allows: it never enables a feature, never grants or refunds anything, and never alters a command that is already running. Reads, cancellations and in-progress runs stay available so nobody is stranded.

rules.productionChange: not available from the panel; needs its own Founder approval and a Production data path

flags.title: Market: new listings
flags.note: Snapshot and cancelling a listing stay available, so a seller can always take an item back.

flags.title: Store: purchases
flags.note: The store can still be browsed.

flags.title: Dungeon: new runs
flags.note: A run already in progress can be continued and finished.

flags.title: Gold/XP Boost: purchase
flags.note: An active boost keeps running and its timer stays visible.

flags.title: Store: $HERO bundles
flags.note: Resources already bought stay with the player.

flags.title: Player reports
flags.note: Reports already sent stay in the Control Center queue.

flags.title: Item upgrades
flags.note: Locking and selling items stay available.
